title: Brain-Claude memory node
description: One node in the Brain-Claude knowledge graph. Emitted by Claude inside a <brain-update>{...}</brain-update> block at session wrap-up, or written directly via `brain.py save`.

user_feedback.description: What worked / what didn't — quote the user verbatim where possible.

metrics.description: Measurable outcomes for this task. Direction decides when a target is met.

name.description: e.g. speed, accuracy, loc, review_rounds, coverage

dir.description: 'min' (default): lower is better, met when value<=target (speed, loc, review_rounds). 'max': higher is better, met when value>=target (coverage, accuracy, tests_passing).

source.description: Provenance. 'self': authored by the model (self-reported — do not fabricate). 'measured': computed by the shell via `brain.py annotate`. Defaults to 'self' when omitted.

lessons_learned.description: Refined process to apply next time.

related_nodes.description: node_ids of related past nodes — these are the graph edges.

pending_items.description: Unfinished next-steps to surface in a future session.
